name: Shree Precoated Steels Limited
summary: Shree Precoated Steels Ltd. primarily operates within the real estate sector, focusing on the acquisition and disposition of development rights, direct property investment, and the trading of residential units. The company also actively explores new ventures in real estate development and redevelopment projects. Chhotalal S. Ajmera established the company on March 18, 1985, and its principal office is situated in Mumbai, India.
